name: Gästehaus Rettenbacher
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Rettenbacher in Fulpmes in the Stubai Valley is operated as a hotel. The practically furnished rooms each feature a private en-suite bathroom. Situated in a peaceful location on the edge of the village, the property offers picturesque views of the Stubai Alps. The interior is decorated in a charming traditional alpine style. Amenities include a cosy lounge with a fireplace and an inviting sun terrace. Each morning, a generous buffet breakfast is served in the breakfast room. The surrounding area features scenic hiking trails and the Schlick 2000 ski resort for winter sports enthusiasts.
